metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the bench, the school door, the second lesson, dinner at the bakehouse, the oak on the burned row, the boats under the bridge, the path to Hewlands, and the sheet under its stone.

yesterday: The cousin's frame goes up on Tuesday at seven. Twelve men. The ale after is at the cousin's charge. The twenty shillings is already in the timber. It was said once, at the bakehouse, and the children heard it. On the way home the four bays were lying at the end plot, green oak, almost yellow.
The penny loaf was small. Anne put it on the scale, and it met the assize. Sadler gave the wheat as six-and-thirty shillings the quarter, from Thursday.
You slept the second lesson. Anne let you. You woke when it was over.
Susanna asked why they did not use the door. You told her the book does not say. The memo at home repeats that answer.
You stopped a tale of the stile before you had finished it. Anne heard the stop. Bartholomew said the wheat was thin, and said to leave it.
The eighteenth is the carrier, at a horse's pace. What you carry is the pack, the sheets, and the inkhorn.
The orchard sheet is still on the bench, under the stone. You read it once, in the morning, and the pen stayed in the knot-hole. At dusk you looked at it from the door and stayed on your feet.
